title: Generic trees
subtitle: Think in hierarchies.
description: Start with roots, branches, and leaves. Learn the vocabulary every tree problem shares.
outcomes: Recognize a hierarchy and its subtrees
Represent a node with a children list
Walk a tree with DFS and BFS

title: Binary trees
subtitle: Two children. A world of possibilities.
description: Understand left and right, compare tree shapes, and build your first recursive operations.
outcomes: Model left and right child links
Recognize full, complete, perfect, and skewed trees
Connect height to the cost of an operation

title: Binary search trees
subtitle: Let order guide the search.
description: Use the BST invariant to search, insert, delete, and validate. Understand when balance matters.
outcomes: Apply the invariant to an entire subtree
Trace a search from root to target
Explain O(h), balanced O(log n), and skewed O(n)

title: Tree traversals
subtitle: Same tree. Four ways to see it.
description: Compare preorder, inorder, postorder, and level order. Choose an order that matches the job.
outcomes: Connect DFS to a stack and BFS to a queue
Explain traversal time and auxiliary space
